## Activity

During April 2021, North City Eye Clinic recorded 339 captures. This provides the activity total for the reporting month and supports routine monitoring of the clinic’s imaging workload. The capture activity should continue to be reviewed alongside image quality and grading outcomes to identify any operational issues requiring follow-up.

## Image quality

Of the images captured, 9 were ungradable. The ungradable rate was 2.7 per cent. This result should be monitored through the site’s usual quality assurance arrangements. The clinic lead asks that recurring camera issues are logged with the service desk so that equipment-related problems can be tracked and addressed through the appropriate process.

## Grading

Grading identified 70 referable results during April 2021. The median lag from photograph capture to grading was 1 day. This measure should continue to be reviewed with the grading results to support timely handling of images requiring further attention. Overall, the activity, image quality and grading figures provide a concise view of the clinic’s operations for the month.
